title: CI build result
description: One pinned build of a runtime version with its toolchain versions, CLI version and Node.js major, and its outcome. Stored under data/verified/<package>/ as <timestamp>_<version>_<pinned versions>.json. A success is final. A failure is suspect until a second, independent run fails the same combination (attempts >= 2); a later success outranks any failure.

package.description: The runtime package that was built.

toolchains.description: Toolchain versions the build used, by key.

with.description: Pinned environment: the CLI version and the Node.js major.

resolved.description: Exact versions observed on the runner, for the record.

evidence.description: URL of the workflow run that proved it.

attempts.description: For failures: how many independent runs have failed this combination, this one included.

signature.description: The last recognisable error line of the failed build.
